### Declared, Precious, and Honored
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/declared-precious-and-honored-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Isaiah 43:4
Points:
- Insecurities and broken relationships can tempt believers to view themselves as burdens.
- God views His children as precious and honored despite their weaknesses and sins.
- The Lord promises to remain present with His people even in self-made messes.
- Our true value comes from Christ's redemption rather than personal performance.

### Fear Not
Author: Sean Michael Lucas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fear-not
Passage: Isaiah 43:1
Points:
- People fixate on worst-case scenarios out of deep fear and feelings of inadequacy.
- God directly commands His people not to fear because He has redeemed them.
- Redemption comes through an intimate, personal calling that anchors the believer in Christ.
- God's promised presence ensures His people will never be consumed by sorrow or trials.

### A Prayer for Our Journey Toward the Promise
Author: Kristine Brown
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-our-journey-toward-the-promise.html
Passage: Isaiah 43:2
Points:
- Life is full of unforeseen twists, rocky roads, and detours.
- Human wandering does not break God's steadfast commitment to guide His people back.
- God promises His accompanying presence through deep waters and intense fires.
- Believers can face frightening circumstances knowing the Lord will preserve them.

### What to Do in Tough Times
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-october-24.html
Passage: Isaiah 43:1-2, 4
Points:
- Bleak headlines and economic anxieties easily stoke fear about what lies ahead.
- Believers belong securely to God because Christ has fully purchased and redeemed them.
- Hardships in life are inevitable, but Christians never have to face them alone.
- Knowing God cherishes and values His people provides enduring confidence through adversity.
